data.gender_notes: Vedang is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vedang means 'knowledge' or 'wisdom' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'veda' which means 'knowledge' or 'wisdom'. The name is used to convey the idea of a deep and profound understanding of the world around us. The name Vedang carries the meaning “Knowledge, Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vedang usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge, wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vedang is a spiritual name that represents the seeker of knowledge and wisdom. It is believed that those named Vedang are blessed with a deep understanding of the universe and a strong desire to learn and grow.
data.etymology: Vedang belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge, Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vedang total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
